events.description: A sudden impact between vehicles at 5.0s produces sparks, smoke, and debris; the white car’s side window is shattered and blood-splattered by 8.5s, with interior view showing driver slumped and rear window also damaged.

verification.reason: Frames f4–f7 show bright sparks and smoke consistent with metal-on-metal collision; f11–f15 show blood and shattered glass on the white car’s passenger-side window; f16–f20 show rear view with heavily damaged rear windshield and driver motionless—collectively indicating a single high-impact crash event, not explosion or shooting. Candidate 1 (Explosion) is subsumed: no blast wave or fireball, only localized sparks from impact. Candidates 0, 3, 4 all describe parts of the same crash sequence and are merged.

events.description: Multiple bullet holes appear on a dark car surface in rapid succession, with visible spalling and deformation consistent with high-velocity impacts.

verification.reason: Frames f5–f8 show progressive appearance of distinct, irregular perforations with surrounding material ejection and blue-white flash artifacts typical of ballistic impact; no gun is visible but the pattern and timing strongly indicate repeated gunfire at the vehicle. The event begins at f5 (30.0 s) and stabilizes by f8 (31.5 s); f4 (29.5 s) shows the pre-impact state, so t_start = 29.5 is acceptable as onset.
